name: Immigration Institute of the Bay Area
description: Free and low-cost immigration legal services and consultations
fullDescription: The Immigration Institute of the Bay Area (IIBA) provides free and low-cost immigration legal services, education, and citizenship classes from seven offices in six Northern California counties.
whatTheyOffer:
- Immigration legal consultations with an attorney or accredited representative
- Citizenship and naturalization help (N-400, N-600, fee waivers)
- Family petitions and green cards (I-130, adjustment of status)
- DACA renewals and Advance Parole
- Humanitarian relief and deportation defense
- Immigration clinics, free citizenship classes, and Know Your Rights
howToGetIt:
1. Call the IIBA office nearest you: San Francisco (415-538-8100), Redwood City (650-587-1558), Oakland (510-451-2846), Fremont, Brentwood (925-237-8581), Napa (707-266-1568), or Petaluma (707-932-7000)
2. Consultations are by appointment only (some offices also offer online booking)
3. Speak with an IIBA attorney or qualified legal representative about your options
4. No one is denied service due to inability to pay
keywords: IIBA, Immigration Institute, immigration legal, citizenship, naturalization, green card, DACA, family petition, know your rights, deportation
